d: Manage multiple IT projects aligned with business goals through clear scope definition, structured planning, proactive risk management and effective stakeholder coordination. Deliver projects within agreed timelines, budgets and quality standards.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.
4–6 years of project management experience, focused on IT projects, particularly AI, advanced technology or software development.
At least 1–2 years of experience managing multiple projects simultaneously within the overall experience requirement.
Certification such as PMP, PMI-ACP or equivalent.
Strong skills in project planning, budgeting, resource coordination, risk management and stakeholder communication.
Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies.
Ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and manage vendor performance.
r: Define project scope, objectives, deliverables and acceptance criteria in alignment with business requirements.
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules and resource allocations to support efficient delivery.
Establish stakeholder communication plans and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
Identify and manage project risks, issues and dependencies, implementing mitigation plans and corrective actions.

d: Principal Electrical Engineer – with a minimum of 12+ years of progressive experience in protection, control, metering and power system analysis for substations and electrical networks up to and including 115 kV in the Oil & Gas, hydrocarbon, and Infrastructure industries. Demonstrated leadership of a medium team of electrical engineers and designers and experience in Conceptual, FEED, and detailed engineering of medium to large scale projects required.
q: Minimum Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, and a minimum of 12+ years in Oil & Gas industry, hydrocarbon, petroleum refinery and infrastructure industries.

Expert knowledge and understanding of protection engineering design practices, including protection philosophy, scheme development, relay application and settings, protection & metering drawings, AC/DC schematics, tripping logic, interlocking, CT/VT selection and protection interfaces for electrical systems up to 115 kV.
Wide knowledge of codes and industry standards IEEE, NFPA, API, IEC, ANSI/NEMA.
Wide knowledge in Electrical Power Systems, Protection Philosophy & Protection Device Coordination.
Knowledge of Saudi Aramco, SABIC Standards and procedures will be an added advantage.
r: Lead a team of 5 to 8 electrical engineers and designers

Develop discipline work plans for protection engineering activities, including protection philosophy, scheme development, relay settings, coordination studies, protection drawings and vendor document reviews.
Develop and review protection schemes and specifications for GIS, transformers, busbars, feeders, motors, generators and other electrical equipment for systems up to 115 kV

Provide SME-level technical leadership and guidance to project teams and clients on protection philosophy, scheme selection, relay application, metering, interlocking, trip logic and protection interfaces
Prepare/review MR and TBE and perform detailed Vendor NMR reviews for GIS, protection relays, protection and control panels, metering systems, PSA/SCADA interfaces and related electrical equipment.
Responsible for design integrity of electrical scope, performance of assigned staff, on-schedule delivery of the work within budget
Lead technical presentations to Clients and their representatives as required
